//DEPLOYMENT: Demo configuration: contains no operator-specific domains, hosts or IP addresses.
Each installation sets its own values via environment variables (e.g. Cors__AllowedOrigins__0,
Jwt__Issuer, Routing__Valhalla__BaseUrl) or a git-ignored appsettings.Production.json.

Cors.//: Frontend origins (scheme://host[:port], no path, no trailing slash), e.g. https://routing.example.com. Required outside Development; an empty list stops the start.

Jwt.//: Issuer and audience of the issued tokens. Use a value unique to your installation, e.g. your API host name.

Security.//: IP addresses of reverse proxies allowed to set X-Forwarded-For/-Proto. Empty: forwarded headers are not evaluated (direct Kestrel or IIS hosting).

OpenApi.//: Metadata shown in Swagger UI. Blank optional fields are omitted from the document.
OpenApi.Title: SmartRouting API
OpenApi.Description: API der SmartRouting-Software zur Planung von Sammeltouren.

Valhalla.//: Root URL of your own Valhalla instance (no path). No default in code; startup fails when missing or malformed.

Emissions.FactorSource: Startwerte in HBEFA-Groessenordnung fuer Abfallsammelfahrzeuge - nicht kalibriert
